# Inspection clause

An unpublished domain specialization of `Documents/Document Base`. The same clause
supports local creation and a provider-supplied running document. It requires an
explicit `inspector` role and freezes the scope identifier and review standard.

The inspection document owns findings, completion and the inspector's authority.
Preparation, typed customization, additional-party consent, access and named-source
linking use the shared engine. An attachment alone is never an inspection result.
The current supported standard is `approved-scope-review`.
